_comment: Expected hardware per board (Nathan, 2026-11-23). Tracked. boards.local.json names each USB serial's profile with "board". Levels: required = must be detected, cannot be marked not fitted (the IMU and baro: the parts that will become integral to every board, Nathan 2026-11-23). Parts are generic: imu means whichever IMU is fitted, baro whichever baro, not a particular chip; expected = must be detected unless scripts/ci/gate_inhibits.json marks it not fitted for a branch; optional = the usual setup but never mandatory: checked when detected, N/A by name when not (radio, GPS). A push that changes radio code ([radio] in firmware_paths.txt) requires the radio on every benched board (Nathan 2026-11-23: require what the code under test needs); absent = not expected, a detection is a warning only. Typical setup source: docs/hardware/HARDWARE.md, Typical Bench Setup table (expected = Typical there).

feather_rp2350._note: IMU and baro are required but sit on separate STEMMA breakouts for now and may change (Nathan, 2026-11-23). GPS: PA1010D on the STEMMA chain is the usual setup (HARDWARE.md, Qwiic chain order Board, GPS, Baro, IMU) but optional.

fruit_jam._note: GPS optional: a spare PA1010D is sometimes fitted for range and extra sensor tests; the station is built to work without it (Nathan, 2026-11-23).
